daemon_user.description: System user under which the OnionBalance daemon runs.

pidfile_path.description: Path to the PID file used by the init script to track daemon process.

config_file_path.description: Path to the main OnionBalance configuration file.

log_directory.description: Directory where OnionBalance logs its output.

tor_control_socket.description: Path to the Unix domain socket of the local Tor control interface (e.g., /run/tor/control.socket). Requires Tor to be configured with ControlSocket enabled.

state_directory.description: Persistent state directory where OnionBalance saves service descriptors, session keys, and internal metadata.

descriptor_directory.description: Directory for storing plaintext descriptor files (if not using state_directory only). Optional but recommended for diagnostics.

debug.description: Enable verbose logging for debugging. Set to true during setup or troubleshooting; false for production.

services.description: List of hidden services to load-balance. Each service must have a .onion hostname and at least one backend.

max_upload_threads.description: Maximum number of parallel descriptor upload jobs to Tor. Increase if upload latency is high.

upload_timeout.description: Timeout (seconds) per descriptor upload attempt. Increase on slow or unreliable Tor control connections.
